sources.title: Omenator AI — Universal 27B Blackwell NVFP4 Optimization Engine
sources.snippet: Omenator AI takes a full ~27B-parameter model straight from a Hugging Face repository and autonomously engineers the highest-quality practical representation that runs on a 16 GB NVIDIA Blackwell GPU — targeting ~3.5 effective bits per parameter while keeping every parameter.
